verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hosted Git service, so a natural-language interface is a fair thing to ask of it, but the evidence shows no built-in natural-language command capability. The official MCP server (gitea-mcp) and the tea CLI do exist. They are programmatic integration points that need an external AI agent to supply the natural-language layer, and they belong to the separate MCP-server and CLI stories, so they earn no credit here.
